layman_headline: Bitcoin's massive breakout above $71K is lifting the entire crypto market — time to ride the wave with Solana.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin just smashed through a six-week trading range and hit $71,000, wiping out $3 billion in short positions. This kind of explosive move typically pulls up high-quality altcoins with a lag. Our existing ETH and HYPE positions are in good shape, and now Solana looks like the next horse to ride — it's up 13% today but still 15% behind ETH's weekly gains, suggesting room to catch up. The overall market mood has swung from fear to greed in just days, with massive ETF inflows confirming institutional demand.
layman_action: Consider adding a Solana position on any dip toward $85, with a clear stop-loss at $77 to limit downside to about 9%. Current ETH and HYPE holdings should be kept — both are within their trade plans.
expert_reasoning: The macro setup is strong: BTC broke a multi-week range with extreme volume, ETF inflows hit $517M (largest since May), and $3B in shorts were liquidated — creating a reflexive bid. SOL at $87.26 is participating but lagging ETH and HYPE on a 7-day basis, which often resolves with a catch-up move in bull phases. BTC dominance at 58.6% is high but may start rotating into alts as the rally matures. The Fear & Greed index jumped from 46 to 62 in one day, and the weekly average of 39.6 shows this greed phase is early. Fed liquidity promises and dollar weakness provide a supportive macro backdrop. Entry near $85 on a pullback offers a favorable risk/reward with $77 stop (9% risk) versus $100 target (18% upside).
risk_factors: BTC dominance at 58.6% is high — capital may continue concentrating in BTC rather than flowing to alts like SOL
Market has moved very fast (BTC +11.6% in 24h) — a sharp pullback or consolidation could drag SOL down 10-15%
Fear & Greed jumped from 46 to 62 rapidly — historically these quick sentiment swings can reverse just as fast
watch_list: BTC price action around $72K resistance — a rejection here could trigger broad alt selloff
ETH position approaching exit target of $2,520 — monitor for partial or full exit
Daily ETF flow data over the next 48 hours to confirm institutional demand is sustained
market_context: Bitcoin has broken out above $71K on massive volume with $3B in short liquidations and $517M in ETF inflows, shifting the market from neutral-fear to greed. This is a powerful risk-on environment, but the speed of the move warrants disciplined entries with tight stops.
context_banner: A massive BTC short squeeze and record ETF inflows have ignited a broad crypto rally — the best swing setups are in high-quality alts that are lagging the move.

key_signals.description: Bitcoin ETFs drew $517M in the largest one-day inflow since early May, confirming strong institutional demand behind the breakout.
Bitcoin broke out of a six-week range above $71K with $3B in short liquidations, creating powerful upward momentum across crypto.
Fear & Greed surged from 46 to 62 in one day with a weekly average of 39.6, indicating early-stage greed — supportive but not yet euphoric.
SOL 24h volume at $5.76B signals massive institutional and retail participation, validating the breakout across the alt space.
Fed liquidity promises and dollar weakness are creating a favorable macro tailwind for risk assets including crypto.
